title: Add A2A idempotency metadata
summary: Extend A2A task envelopes with explicit idempotency metadata (duplicate safety + key) so automatic retry can be implemented without hiding duplicate-work risk.
expectedFailureModes: A2A tasks cannot declare duplicate safety, so retry remains either unsafe or permanently disabled.
Schema changes break backward-compatible JSON reads for stored mailbox logs.
Docs imply idempotency exists while the daemon ignores it.
nextAction: Add optional idempotency fields to A2ATask + queue entries, keep them backwards compatible, and document the operator meaning.
